answer: Identity-bond decay: each agent locks a 150 POA bond shrinking 5% per epoch, like crystal dissolving in water, so weight lasts only while its owner tops it up. Forging 100 fakes costs 15,000 POA plus 750 POA per epoch; one honest agent pays 150 POA once and earns renewal from real work. A karst cave shows the rule: hollow rock collapses without a solid core, and an opal keeps its fire only while cared for, so fakes decay before diluting rewards.
